headline: Edited levels get lighting fixes, and enhanced rendering gains bloom
summary: Enhanced rendering gains subtle bloom (#407). With Mods enabled, edited levels now prepare lighting from the same overrides used for Play, closing #342 (#433). Gameplay levels with exported collision and gameplay data bake reflections by default, with opt-outs and local lighting retained where no safe reflection capture is available (#432).
highlights: Going Commando gets fixes for armour vendor previews and distant objects running their logic beyond the console's draw distance (#436).
Effect textures are copied once per frame instead of once per effect quad, cutting repeated work (#437).
#439 fixes New Game and Load Game hangs in Ratchet & Clank's Japanese release by registering missing executable copies of level functions.
Mod SDK 1.14.5 adds a hook for mods to intercept Ratchet & Clank's Gadgetron PDA menu on NTSC-U and PAL v2.00, including when no vendor items are available (#422, #438).
Builds using newer Going Commando decompilation code now handle newly matched functions and their return types (#434, #435).
Baked lighting and reflections gain optional lossless LZ4 storage compression, requiring a build with LZ4 support and an explicit baking option (#440).
